prompt: Who was the head coach of the team that won the Superbowl the year that the show Law & Order: SVU was released?
answer: *Law & Order: Special Victims Unit* premiered in **1999**. The Super Bowl held that year was **Super Bowl XXXIII**, won by the **Denver Broncos**. Their head coach was **Mike Shanahan**.
